summary: Verified CORS fix for 'Failed to fetch' error on /application form. The fix removed allow_credentials=True from CORSMiddleware in server.py, which was causing browsers to block responses due to CORS spec violation (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * cannot be combined with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true). All 7 backend tests pass. Frontend E2E test confirms form submission works and success modal appears.

rca_of_issues: Root Cause Analysis: The 'Failed to fetch' error was caused by CORS spec violation. The CORSMiddleware had allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True. Per CORS spec (https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#http-access-control-allow-credentials), when Access-Control-Allow-Origin is *, the browser MUST ignore Access-Control-Allow-Credentials. Additionally, with credentials mode, Access-Control-Allow-Origin cannot be *. The fix was to remove allow_credentials=True since the app doesn't use credentials (cookies/auth headers) for cross-origin requests. This allows the browser to properly handle the * wildcard origin.
